SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM AnimeGenres AS tg WHERE tg.anime_id = t.anime_id ) AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM AnimeGenres AS tg2 WHERE tg2.anime_id = t.anime_id AND tg2.genre_id = 638 ) THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM Anime AS a WHERE a.start_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND ( a.popularity > t.popularity OR (a.popularity = t.popularity AND a.anime_id < t.anime_id) ) AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM AnimeGenres AS ag WHERE ag.anime_id = a.anime_id )
AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM AnimeGenres AS ag2 WHERE ag2.anime_id = a.anime_id AND ag2.genre_id = 638 ) ) END AS yearSeasonRank FROM Anime AS t WHERE t.anime_id = #{animeId}
